project: Wuxia Life P88 Medical Payoff Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for medical_sage_healer payoff phase (2 variants × 3 choices = 6 branches) — define payoff direction, contract, and validation shape before implementation, preserving tavern-born healer flavor and variant differentiation.

userStories.title: Audit medical payoff prerequisites (2 variants)
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the medical payoff stage covering both variants so P88 starts from the real gating surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing medical route flags, markers, events, and expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp + pressure)
Identify what exists before payoff vs what can be reused for both compassionate and pragmatic variants
Document variant-specific differences and commonalities
Save docs/test-reports/p88-medical-payoff-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Covers both compassionate and pragmatic variants. Inventories all existing surfaces before payoff design begins.

userStories.title: Lock P88 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P88 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P88 to gap audit, direction comparison, payoff contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, late-life design
Save docs/test-reports/p88-medical-payoff-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope guardrails to keep P88 design-only. Zero runtime changes allowed.

userStories.title: Compare medical payoff directions (2 variants × 3 choices)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want payoff-direction options for both medical variants so P88 chooses the most differentiated and bounded payoff shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm choice-based payoff mode (2 variants × 3 choices = 6 branches)
Compassionate variant: compare at least 3 choice directions (e.g. hold-on / let-go / find-legacy)
Pragmatic variant: compare at least 3 choice directions (e.g. hold-favors / break-free / master-favors)
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, tavern-born fit, implementation complexity
Select recommended direction and document rejected alternatives for each variant
Recommendation follows quality-first and small-step principles
Ensure 2 variants have genuinely different payoff arcs (not reskinned)
Save comparison document
userStories.notes: Core design work — 2 variants each with 3 meaningful choices. Must maintain variant differentiation and tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Define medical payoff contract (2 variants)
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit payoff contract for both variants so P89 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define payoff checkpoint, required flags, and corresponding gate acceptance
Define 2 core payoff events (compassionate + pragmatic, both choice-based)
Define stat changes, identity markers, and expression differences per choice for both variants
Define at least 5 payoff-specific player-facing signals (cost label, current goal, age40 identity, life memory, summary)
Clarify difference between payoff vs pressure and vs generic midlife for both variants
Preserve tavern-born medical healer flavor throughout
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent late-life / endgame stages
Save contract to docs/PRD/p88-medical-payoff-contract.md
userStories.notes: Contract LOCK for P89 implementation. 2 variants × 3 choices = 6 full branches with complete specs.

userStories.title: Define P89 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P89 validation shape fixed in advance so playable payoff work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which chain nodes targeted proof must show (pressure → payoff → expression changes)
Both variants × 3 choices: each direction must have core node verification
Define which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum
Define what evidence counts as payoff closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define regression boundaries for P83/P84/P85/P87 existing evidence
userStories.notes: Pre-commit to P89 validation shape. Covers all 6 payoff branches + cross-variant differentiation + regression boundaries.

userStories.title: Produce P88 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the medical payoff design-first contract and hands off to P89.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p88-medical-payoff-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, payoff-direction comparison, payoff contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P89
List remaining deferred larger medical-expansion items
State GO / NO-GO for payoff implementation stage
userStories.notes: Closure and GO/NO-GO for P89 medical payoff playable implementation stage.
